metadata.purpose: Generate pre-training single-layer/source STEM simulation images for the CrBr3 training config.
metadata.source_generation_scope: This source generator only applies simulator-level variations such as thermal displacement and defects. Crop, rotation, scan noise, display adjustment, and other training augmentations are applied later by configs/train/CrBr3.yml during training.
metadata.image_size_note: CrBr3 uses 1712 x 1024 because incostem naturally emits this size for the supplied CrBr3 structure when the input width is 1712; this keeps source PNGs aligned with the public mask without modifying the generator.
